selection_policy: Primary cryptographic standards and current Go standard/official extension documentation for owner authentication, key derivation, key wrapping, trust-anchor integrity, secure randomness and time semantics.

sources.title: RFC 9106 — Argon2
limitations: Parameters still need operational latency validation on target hardware

sources.title: golang.org/x/crypto/argon2
limitations: External module rather than Go standard library

sources.title: Go crypto/rand
supports: cryptographically secure random bytes for root keys, salts and nonces
limitations: Random generation does not define key custody

sources.title: NIST SP 800-38D — GCM
supports: AES-GCM authenticated encryption for confidentiality and integrity
limitations: Nonce uniqueness and key management remain application responsibilities

sources.title: Go crypto/aes
limitations: constant-time properties depend on hardware support

sources.title: Go crypto/cipher
limitations: safe nonce lifecycle remains caller responsibility

sources.title: RFC 5869 — HKDF
supports: derive independent labeled subkeys from a root key

sources.title: Go crypto/hmac
supports: keyed HMAC and constant-time comparison helper
limitations: rollback detection requires a key/trust anchor outside the rolled-back store

sources.title: Go time
supports: serialized Time representations do not preserve process monotonic-clock semantics
limitations: monotonic time cannot directly establish freshness across process restart

sources.title: FIPS 180-4 — Secure Hash Standard
supports: SHA-256 hash primitive used under HMAC/HKDF
